methodology.ranking: Major Algerian national and private channels, ordered first by Kantar Africascope 2025 viewing evidence and then by current national carriage and public-service prominence
methodology.publication_rule: Exact live linear channel, three real audio/video decode passes, moving current programming, and cloud-hosted Apple-compatible delivery that does not depend on this Mac

latest_audit.source_rotation: Official broadcaster websites and app stores, EPTV's current official YouTube roster, Echorouk site and YouTube lives, El Watania's first-party embedded Ant Media player, current ParaTV and iptv-org resolvers, TDA carriage, and licensed OTT/FAST catalogs
latest_audit.published_regression: GitHub Actions run 30173846777 passed canonical/alias parity and all 36 local-copy plus all 36 public Apple-TV-path playback attempts for the 12 published channels. The forced IPTVX reload retained all 12 identities, and the repaired Almagharibia relay sustained changing video after the reload. TV6 remains quarantined rather than forgotten.
evidence: Kantar Africascope 2025 ranks Samira TV and Echorouk TV first and second among channels watched in Algeria; El Heddaf TV, Ennahar TV, and ENTV Programme National also appear in its current top ten.

Télédiffusion d’Algérie's current official satellite roster confirms Samira TV, Echorouk TV, Echorouk News, El Hayat TV, and El Watania TV as carried Algerian services alongside the already-published private channels and the EPTV public bouquet.

Samira's official Samira+ app advertises international 24/7 HD live viewing, but the current public website exposes only app-store launch paths; no stable public non-DRM manifest suitable for IPTVX was available in this audit.

Echorouk's official live page generated a current signed Echorouk TV HLS URL, but three independent requests from the US terminated at the CDN without returning media. No geo-bypass was attempted and the channel remains unpublished.

Echorouk's separate official live-news page generated a fresh signed Echorouk News HLS URL, but three independent requests from the US likewise returned no media response. The only responsive alternative belonged to an unverified third-party distributor, so it was rejected despite returning HTTP 200.

TV6 failed two complete three-attempt public gates: timeout, TLS/no-response, malformed 0p video, and corrupt H.264/PPS evidence recurred. The former official HTA hostname also failed DNS resolution in seven parallel source probes, so TV6 was quarantined without deleting its target or source history.

El Watania's official website now embeds a first-party live player whose exact HLS endpoint decoded current 1920x1080 H.264/AAC video with the El Watania watermark and a current Algeria-time clock. It is not yet publishable: two complete three-attempt gates returned no-response or motion timeouts, and decoding 30 seconds of media took 88 seconds, which would visibly stall on Apple TV.

Samira+'s current official Google Play and App Store listings still advertise an international 24/7 HD live service, but the website exposes only account/app launch paths and the official Samira YouTube channel was not live during this run.

Echorouk TV and Echorouk News each failed a fresh three-attempt gate at the official CDN. Neither official YouTube channel had a playable live broadcast; Echorouk News exposed only an upcoming event that had not begun.

EPTV's current official site exposes YouTube identities for TV6, TV8, and TV9. All three exact official channels were checked and none was currently live; the previously failed TV6 HLS path remains quarantined.

No exact, current, publicly authorized non-DRM linear feed was found for El Hayat TV, TV8 Adhakira, or TV9 El Barlamaniya. Their official identities and search history remain in this registry rather than being discarded.

Almagharibia's direct cloud wrapper is refreshed every 20 minutes by GitHub Actions from the live identity exposed by the broadcaster's official app. The public relay now tries that wrapper first and independently races the official YouTube player resolver if the wrapper is rejected by its egress. The layered endpoint passed the complete public GitHub Actions playback gate and sustained changing video after a fresh IPTVX playlist reload.
latest_audit.result: No newly viable exact channel qualified; TV6 was quarantined after repeat persistent failure, leaving 12 of the 20 durable targets published.
